## Load Libraries 
```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)

#view(penguins)

```

This loads the libraries I need to use for my code. 

## Dataset Description 

There are `r nrow(penguins)` penguins rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.

The mean bill length (mn) is `r round(mean(penguins$bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))` .
